notes: Only the Parcoursup page is the programme's own page; the Campus France Maroc pages are general and country-level. The progressive English tracks mentioned on the Parcoursup page (Travaux Dirigés en langue anglaise, cycle école taught mainly in English) are optional or later-cycle elements; the licence itself is taught in French. The application channel is not output here because a Moroccan Bac holder applies through Études en France / Campus France, which the task says is set separately. Tuition evidence comes from a country-level Campus France page; the French differentiated registration fees for non-EU students (2,902 EUR for a Licence year) are quoted for a non-EU student from Morocco, and exemptions are possible. No deadline for this specific programme for non-EU applicants was found that states a year; the ADIUT Maroc window is quoted only as a manual check because it concerns 1ère année BUT, a different programme. Some quotes are slightly longer than one sentence; they were kept as short as possible while preserving the fact.
